purpose: Teach: それ程/くるくる/エライ/終われ/あたたかい/はっと/通り越し/飛び出す

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、それ程勉強してないだろ?
lines.en: You haven't been studying that hard, have you?
lines.style: Light, teasing challenge with a half-smile. Quick delivery. Calls him out like they've had this conversation before.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、踊りでくるくる回るの上手いな、桜
lines.en: You're actually pretty good at spinning around when you dance, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine observation, a little shy about the compliment. Soft opening. Not trying to impress, just noticing out loud.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テストでエライ点取ったな
lines.en: You did really well on that test, Riku.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, a beat of sincerity. Not overdoing it, but making sure he knows she noticed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストの問題、最後まで終われたか?桜
lines.en: Did you actually finish all the test questions, Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle check-in, genuinely curious. Not interrogating—caring enough to ask about what matters.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のあたたかい言葉、ありがとな
lines.en: Thanks for saying that, Riku. It means a lot coming from you.
lines.style: Soft, unguarded sincerity. Slight vulnerability showing through. Trails off gently—doesn't want to make it a big thing but knows it is.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、先生にはっと注意されたな、桜
lines.en: You got called out pretty sharply by the teacher, didn't you?
lines.style: Wry observation, light touch. She's not judging—she's seen it before, and there's warmth underneath the teasing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、停留所を通り越して降りたな
lines.en: You actually got off at the wrong bus stop, didn't you?
lines.style: Dry, quick-witted catch. Eyebrow raised. The kind of thing you say to a friend when they've obviously zoned out.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、教室を飛び出すように帰ったろ?桜
lines.en: You just bolted out of the classroom to leave, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Observant, slightly suspicious, but curious more than accusatory. Leaning in to understand what's actually going on.
